snippet.title: The Hollowing - The First Horror Flight Simulator - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist and play the demo HERE: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4882000 

You’ve taken a maintenance job, flying between the inter-settlement comms towers in the megastructure. Land, fix, on to the next job. What could go wrong? The Hollowing is a narrative first-person horror flight sim from the creator of Lorn's Lure.
